traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md is a clear specification. The implementation in the valid-annotation-format rule introduces JSDoc tag boundary detection via normalizeCommentLine and isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine and updates the comment-line state machine to terminate or continue annotations according to JSDoc tags. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly cover traceability before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags, multi-line annotations preceding tags, and the original bug scenario where @param content was concatenated into a requirement ID. The rule documentation has a dedicated "JSDoc coexistence" section with examples that match the story’s requirements. All relevant tests pass under Jest, indicating the acceptance criteria (behavior, tests, and documentation) are fully met with no observed regressions. Therefore this story is fully implemented.
